from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u009/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cross_r = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 3 for v in row))
    cross_c = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 3 for r in range(h)))
    out = []
    for r in range(h):
        row = []
        for c in range(w):
            if r == cross_r or c == cross_c:
                row.append(3)
            else:
                row.append(4 if max(abs(r - cross_r), abs(c - cross_c)) % 2 == 0 else 0)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
p=programs/'task-90824e72.py'
p.write_text(source)
print(p)
